title: Intelligent Intrusion Detection System
summary: A network intrusion detection system pairing a deep-learning classifier trained on NSL-KDD with a synthetic-data generation module to address class imbalance in attack traffic. It vendors an in-tree copy of the CTGAN package (whose transformer code depends on rdt) under backend/src/CTGAN and exposes it through a FastAPI router, so CTGAN is vendored and run to synthesize network security data.
evidence: backend/src/CTGAN/preprocessing/data_transformer.py:5 imports rdt.transformers; api.CTGAN.routes wired into main.py FastAPI app
needs: No direct call site of CTGAN.fit/sample observed; only the router wiring and vendored transformer confirm intended use.
